description:
Affected extension: auto-commit-on-exit.ex
Upstream: ctx.sessionManager.getEntries() returns all entries in the session transcript. Used by auto-commit-on-exit.ts to walk backwards through entries, find the last assistant message, and derive a meaningful commit message from its text content.
Current workaround: commit message is derived from ctx.cwd (directory name) instead.
What's needed: Context.t() must expose session entries (or a lazy accessor) so extensions can read the transcript. Likely a get_entries fn field on Context, or a new entries field populated by Interactive/AgentSession when dispatching events.
Upstream: tmp/pi-mono/packages/coding-agent/examples/extensions/auto-commit-on-exit.ts (ctx.sessionManager.getEntries())
title: ctx.sessionManager.getEntries() — expose full session transcript to Context
